{{Nihongo|'''Masahiro Kawasaki'''|川崎 真弘|Kawasaki Masahiro|15 September 1949 – 4 May 2006}} was a Japanese musician and composer, born in [[Kitakyushu, Fukuoka]]. As a musician, he played keyboards in a number of bands, including [[Ryudo Uzaki]]'s Ryūdōgumi.<ref name="47news">{{cite web|script-title=ja:川崎真弘氏死去 作曲家|trans-title=Composer Masahiro Kawasaki dies|url=http://www.47news.jp/CN/200605/CN2006050601004962.html|work=47 News|publisher=Press Net Japan Co., Ltd|date=6 May 2006|accessdate=19 January 2013|language=Japanese}}</ref> As a composer for film, television, and [[anime]], he won awards of excellence at the [[Japan Academy Prize (film)|Japan Academy Prize]] for his film scores for ''[[Rampo (film)|Rampo]]''<ref>{{cite web|script-title=ja:第18回日本アカデミー賞優秀作品|trans-title=18th Japan Academy Prize selected works|url=http://www.japan-academy-prize.jp/prizes/?t=18|publisher=Japan Academy Prize Association|accessdate=17 January 2013|language=Japanese}}</ref> and ''Kin'yu Fushoku Rettō: Jubaku''.<ref>{{cite web|script-title=ja:第23回日本アカデミー賞優秀作品 |trans-title=23rd Japan Academy Prize selected works |url=http://www.japan-academy-prize.jp/prizes/?t=23 |publisher=Japan Academy Prize Association |accessdate=17 January 2013 |language=Japanese |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20141031043947/http://www.japan-academy-prize.jp/prizes/?t=23 |archivedate=31 October 2014 }}</ref> He was also nominated for best original film score for the Taiwanese film ''[[Rice Rhapsody]]'' at the [[Golden Horse Awards]].<ref>{{cite web|title=Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival – Archive 2004 |url=http://www.goldenhorse.org.tw/ui/index.php?class=ghac&func=archive&search_regist_year=2004&nwlist_type=award |publisher=Taipei Golden Horse Film Festival |accessdate=19 January 2013 |language=Chinese |url-status=dead |archiveurl=https://web.archive.org/web/20130921055404/http://www.goldenhorse.org.tw/ui/index.php?class=ghac&func=archive&search_regist_year=2004&nwlist_type=award |archivedate=21 September 2013 }}</ref>

He died of [[Hepatocellular carcinoma|liver cancer]] at the age of 56 on 4 May 2006 in [[Inage-ku, Chiba]].<ref name="47news"/>

==Partial filmography==
* ''[[Kozure Ôkami: Sono chîsaki te ni]]'' (1993)
* ''[[Rampo (film)|Rampo]]'' (1994)
* ''[[Kamikaze Taxi]]'' (1995)
* ''Kin'yu Fushoku Rettō: Jubaku'' (1999)
* ''[[Off-Balance]]'' (2001)
* ''[[Rice Rhapsody]]'' (2004)
